scope: Three selected China-linked civilian deployments and one US disclosure benchmark. A bounded source review, not a market sample or an assessment of September 2026 operating status.

sources.title: How this technical officer and robot SPock hunt hazards to protect Singapore's power tunnels
云深处隧道巡检机器狗首度交付新加坡电网
BMW Group to deploy humanoid robots in production in Germany for the first time
F.02 Contributed to the Production of 30,000 Cars at BMW
2026 interim results announcement
sources.dateNote: Official announcement index and signature on p45; CDN path date is not publication date.

claims.text: SPock performs tunnel anomaly inspection; a technician trained it. Earlier inspections involved two people walking up to 6 km.
claims.limitation: Buyer does not identify the OEM or disclose a matched robot route time, costs or saved person-hours.

claims.text: DEEP identifies X30, integrator Eastern Green Power and SP Group; describes tunnel pilot and localization/inspection adaptations.
claims.limitation: OEM/integrator attribution is supplied by DEEP; integration cost is undisclosed.

claims.locator: 国产机器狗在新加坡‘上岗’，释放人力提升效率; paragraph beginning 日常巡检
claims.text: A technician and colleague walked a 6 km route in 2–3 hours.
claims.denominator: One described manual route; staffing persistence unverified
claims.limitation: Do not enter as robot cycle time or assume all elapsed hours became cash savings.

claims.locator: Same section; paragraphs beginning 随着机器狗 and 据估算
claims.text: Wider SPock deployment is expected to save more than 480 manual tunnel-inspection hours annually.
claims.denominator: Fleet scope and gross/net labor definition undisclosed
claims.limitation: Conditional supplier forecast; not measured savings at the pilot site.

claims.locator: Printed p118 / PDF page119, ESG case box, middle paragraph
claims.text: Walker S1 completed the first BYD trial stage; issuer reports efficiency doubled and stability improved 30%.
claims.excerpt: 效率提升了一倍，穩定性提升了30%
claims.translation: efficiency doubled, and stability improved by 30%
claims.unit: percent change in undefined efficiency and stability measures
claims.period: FY2024 account; exact trial dates unspecified
claims.denominator: Baseline, metric definitions, sample and interval undisclosed
claims.limitation: Neither observed units/hour nor availability; no human comparison established.

claims.locator: Printed p283 / PDF page284, VII(4)(c); related-party identity on p282
claims.text: FY2025 goods sales to related party BYD and subsidiaries were RMB20.898m.
claims.denominator: Related-party customer group; no robot model, unit count, task or site split
claims.limitation: Cannot divide into a robot price or attribute this total to the S1 trial.
A sale is not proof of cash collection; this balance does not resolve invoice or robot scope.

claims.locator: 优必选 x 比亚迪 subsection
claims.text: Describes handling trials within a logistics and manufacturing-software system.
claims.limitation: System-wide benefit does not isolate the humanoid's incremental contribution.

claims.locator: 优必选 x 吉利汽车 subsection; paragraph beginning 在与吉利的合作项目中
claims.text: Walker S Lite undertook three consecutive weeks of trials loading boxes at a Zeekr CTU inbound station.
claims.translation: three consecutive weeks of practical trials
claims.limitation: No site city in this passage; do not import Ningbo from a separate S1 account.

claims.locator: SPS application description, before customer subsections
claims.text: Generic SPS description claims picking/placing two component types within ten seconds.
claims.denominator: No named customer workcell or robot version
claims.limitation: Cannot assign this rate to BYD handling or Zeekr box loading.

claims.text: Describes multi-robot collaboration at Zeekr's 5G smart factory as training/trials.
claims.denominator: Multiple robots and scenes; individual versions unresolved
claims.limitation: Does not upgrade the historical S Lite record to S2 or establish current production economics.

claims.locator: Successful pilot at BMW Group Plant Spartanburg provides key insights; first two paragraphs
claims.text: Figure 02 moved over 90,000 sheet-metal components in around 1,250 operating hours, supporting over 30,000 X3 vehicles.
claims.period: 2025 pilot; described as within ten months
claims.denominator: Reported deployment aggregate; exact dates, robot count and acceptance reconciliation undisclosed
claims.limitation: Moved components are not verified accepted three-part cycles; vehicle count is not robot output.

claims.text: Around 1,250 operating hours; ten-hour weekday shifts.
claims.period: 2025 pilot; described as within ten months
claims.denominator: Runtime definition and fleet aggregation unresolved
claims.limitation: Do not multiply calendar weekdays into scheduled hours or derive downtime from these rounded figures.

claims.locator: Opening paragraph, Deployment Highlights and Hardware Reliability and Learnings
claims.text: Describes an eleven-month deployment, six months of daily runtime, 90,000+ loaded parts and 1,250+ runtime hours.
claims.limitation: Retain the difference from BMW's ten-month account; do not silently align cohorts.

claims.text: Defines an 84-second total cycle and 37-second loading requirement, >99% correct three-part placement target per shift, and zero human-pause/reset goal.
claims.unit: seconds total; seconds loading; percent success target; interventions goal
claims.period: BMW use case; measurement interval unspecified
claims.denominator: Three-part cycle; shift success definition; human pause/reset event
claims.limitation: These are requirements, targets and a goal, not reported achieved success or intervention rates.

claims.locator: Hardware Reliability and Learnings, forearm paragraph
claims.text: Forearm was the leading hardware failure point; Figure describes wrist-electronics changes for Figure 03.
claims.denominator: No failure count or repair-hours distribution
claims.limitation: Failure ranking does not establish failure frequency, repair cost or Figure 03 field reliability.

claims.locator: Printed p11, C.3, final loading/unloading paragraph
claims.text: Issuer reports 75% end-to-end laboratory success for loading/unloading.
claims.excerpt: 在實驗室全流程成功率已經達到75%
claims.translation: end-to-end success in the laboratory has reached 75%
claims.denominator: No named site, robot version, sample count or task timing
claims.limitation: Cannot use this as a BYD S1 or Zeekr S Lite field success rate. P13's mixed control approaches do not quantify human assistance.

deployments.name: DEEP X30 / SPock — SP Group tunnel inspection
deployments.robotModel: X30 base plus SPock solution (supplier attribution)
deployments.siteDescription: Singapore electricity cable tunnel; segment unspecified
deployments.task: Inspect tunnel for anomalies and produce usable reports
deployments.proposedAcceptanceRule: Required route and sensor points covered; customer accepts anomaly report against independently checked hazards.
deployments.periodDescription: Use reported November–December 2024; observation interval unknown
deployments.comparison: Same route by the required human inspection team; assess a fixed-sensor or wheeled inspection alternative where feasible.
deployments.collectionPriority: Matched route logs, safety staffing requirement, review/rescue person-hours, accepted sensor coverage and total integration/service costs.
deployments.decisionAffected: Whether inspection reduces net labor demand, improves coverage, or primarily removes people from hazardous environments.

deployments.name: UBTECH Walker S1 — BYD material handling
deployments.task: Material handling within an integrated logistics workflow
deployments.proposedAcceptanceRule: One identified load reaches its specified destination undamaged, correctly oriented and within the required takt.
deployments.periodDescription: First-stage trial described in FY2024 report; dates unknown
deployments.commercialStage: Supplier-reported trial; later customer-group goods sales do not identify this cell
deployments.comparison: Existing staffed cell and feasible AMR/conveyor/fixed-arm redesign, holding task and surrounding logistics constant.
deployments.collectionPriority: Identify the cell and version, define efficiency/stability, obtain transfer and recovery logs and itemized customer costs.
deployments.decisionAffected: Whether the humanoid improves the complete workflow after support and integration costs.

deployments.name: UBTECH Walker S Lite — Zeekr CTU loading
deployments.siteDescription: Zeekr smart factory CTU inbound-loading station; city unspecified in S Lite passage
deployments.task: Move boxes into a CTU inbound-loading station
deployments.proposedAcceptanceRule: One identified box is accepted by the CTU station undamaged and within the workcell's timing and placement tolerances.
deployments.periodDescription: Three calendar weeks of trials; dates and scheduled hours unknown
deployments.commercialStage: Supplier-reported trials; later multi-robot account does not resolve this version
deployments.comparison: Staffed loading and a compatible AMR-plus-arm cell, including queueing and downstream acceptance.
deployments.collectionPriority: Version/site identity, box dimensions and mass, attempts and accepted placements, productive hours, CTU waiting and human recovery time.
deployments.decisionAffected: Whether this task needs a humanoid and whether its incremental throughput pays for its support burden.

deployments.name: Figure 02 — BMW Spartanburg sheet-metal loading
deployments.site: BMW Group Plant Spartanburg; body shop (exact workcell unspecified)
deployments.task: Load three sheet-metal parts into a welding fixture
deployments.proposedAcceptanceRule: Customer accepts all three parts correctly positioned within the specified cycle; reconcile to weld-fixture output log.
deployments.periodDescription: BMW: ten months in 2025; Figure: eleven months of deployment and six months of daily runtime. Scope unresolved.
deployments.comparison: Same staffed loading operation and feasible fixed automation, including fixture/interface modifications.
deployments.collectionPriority: Reconcile source windows and fleet count; obtain accepted cycles, achieved pause/reset rate, repair time and full customer cost ledger.
deployments.decisionAffected: A disclosure benchmark for task definitions and failure learning; not a China-versus-US productivity ranking.
